about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.text: Senior IT consultant with 20+ years of experience in data architecture and business intelligence. I work on enterprise data platforms — ETL/ELT, Data Vault 2.0, Kimball and medallion modeling, Power BI, SSAS, Azure — and lately I've turned my technical curiosity toward applied AI: local systems, multi-agent architectures with persistent memory, automations that orchestrate models and data without relying on third-party cloud infrastructure. I speak Italian, Spanish, French, Catalan, Dutch and English.
